        About this item

        • YOUR TRAIL GUIDE ON YOUR WRIST: Navigate challenging trails on your run with path, elevation and pace guidance on your Galaxy Watch Ultra2¹. The smart watch gives you personalized hydration alerts² along the way so you can run and feel your best.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Get an easy-to-understand view of your overall heart health³ with a single personalized score⁴ and guidance, so you can avoid the guesswork.
        • INSTANT AI ASSISTANCE. NO SLOWING DOWN: Every second can be crucial when you're outdoors. With Galaxy Watch Ultra2, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁵—no wake phrase needed, no slowing down.
        • GREAT DURABILITY FOR THE GREAT OUTDOORS: From rugged trails to under water, take this fitness watch anywhere as your dependable adventure partner. IP69K and 10ATM rated, it’s dust-tight⁶ and water resistant⁷ up to 100m so you can take on any challenge.
        • YOUR BODY SPEAKS. LISTEN WITH VITALS: Understand your body better with Vitals⁹–it’s built to track 5 different health metrics while you sleep, catch shifts from your usual patterns, and also provide tailored guidance based on the insights.⁸
        • YOUR DIVING GUIDE, BUILT IN: With the dive computer app¹¹ from Mares, this EN13319-certified smartwatch offers real-time indicators like ascent/descent monitoring, limit depth notification, safety stop information, and more.
        • A DISPLAY BUILT FOR BRIGHTER DAYS: Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is made for the outdoors, right down to the display. With up to 5,000 nits of brightness, it delivers exceptional visibility, whether you're on a sunny hike or working out on your lunch break.
        • CELLULAR CONNECTIVITY THAT MOVES WITH YOU: Make calls, send texts and receive important updates—even when your phone stays behind—all from your wrist. Thanks to built-in LTE connectivity¹⁰, this smart fitness tracker keeps you connected to what matters.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹² Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.

        • Which colors are available for Galaxy Watch Ultra2?

          Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is available in Titanium Silver and Titanium Gray.

        • Is the titanium body tough enough for scratches and impacts during outdoor activities?

          Galaxy Watch Ultra2’s titanium body is built to take impact head-on while staying light on your wrist, so it moves naturally with you during extended wear. It resists scratches, dents and wear without adding bulk.

        • Can I wear the Galaxy Watch Ultra2 while swimming in a pool or in the ocean?

          Yes. With 10 ATM water resistance6 and EN13319 certification, Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is built for the water.⁶,⁷ You can wear it confidently while swimming or diving in the pool or open water, down to 40 meters.11

        • What does Galaxy Watch Ultra2 track during a dive? How deep can it go?

          Galaxy Watch Ultra2 tracks your current depth, elapsed dive time and water temperature in real time, helping you stay aware of the changing conditions underwater down to 40 meters.11

        • My Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is charging slowly, do I have to use the charger that comes with it?

          The Galaxy Watch Ultra2 comes with a charger that is specific to its model, and it charges best using only that charger. To get the best charging performance, use provided wireless charger that comes in the box.

        Product Description

        Whether you’re exploring the outdoors, chasing a new personal record or simply working to build healthier habits –Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is our most advanced smartwatch yet –built to be your companion through it all.

        You can now run challenging trails confidently with the all-new Trail Running¹ feature that gives guidance² around path, pace, elevation and more. Running on a sunny day? The 5,000-nit display keeps your screen ultra-bright and visible. Planning on a recreational dive? Watch Ultra2 is EN13319-certified³ for diving, with real-time guidance through the Mares dive computer app.¹¹

        Beyond the outdoors, Watch Ultra2 can be your personal coach with Fitness Index,⁴ which delivers guided training programs tailored to you. And while you’re working on your goals, Heart Health Score and Vitals help you keep tabs on your health and deliver personalized guidance so you can build toward a healthier version of yourself.

        With Watch Ultra2, you can also move lighter without losing connection. Cellular connectivity¹⁰ keeps calls, texts, emails and important updates within reach, even when your phone stays behind. And when your Watch connects to your Galaxy ecosystem, you can Tap to Pay,¹⁴ take your playlists with you on the Watch, control your camera,¹⁵ take calls from your wrist and more, effortlessly.

        Watch Ultra2 combines rugged performance with intelligent guidance, helping you go further and do more with confidence.

        About this Item

        • YOUR TRAIL GUIDE ON YOUR WRIST: Navigate challenging trails on your run with path, elevation and pace guidance on your Galaxy Watch Ultra2¹. The smart watch gives you personalized hydration alerts² along the way so you can run and feel your best.
        • ONE PERSONALIZED SCORE TO KNOW YOUR HEART BETTER: Get an easy-to-understand view of your overall heart health³ with a single personalized score⁴ and guidance, so you can avoid the guesswork.
        • INSTANT AI ASSISTANCE. NO SLOWING DOWN: Every second can be crucial when you're outdoors. With Galaxy Watch Ultra2, you can just raise your wrist, start talking naturally and get instant AI assistance⁵—no wake phrase needed, no slowing down.
        • GREAT DURABILITY FOR THE GREAT OUTDOORS: From rugged trails to under water, take this fitness watch anywhere as your dependable adventure partner. IP69K and 10ATM rated, it’s dust-tight⁶ and water resistant⁷ up to 100m so you can take on any challenge.
        • YOUR BODY SPEAKS. LISTEN WITH VITALS: Understand your body better with Vitals⁹–it’s built to track 5 different health metrics while you sleep, catch shifts from your usual patterns, and also provide tailored guidance based on the insights.⁸
        • YOUR DIVING GUIDE, BUILT IN: With the dive computer app¹¹ from Mares, this EN13319-certified smartwatch offers real-time indicators like ascent/descent monitoring, limit depth notification, safety stop information, and more.
        • A DISPLAY BUILT FOR BRIGHTER DAYS: Galaxy Watch Ultra2 is made for the outdoors, right down to the display. With up to 5,000 nits of brightness, it delivers exceptional visibility, whether you're on a sunny hike or working out on your lunch break.
        • CELLULAR CONNECTIVITY THAT MOVES WITH YOU: Make calls, send texts and receive important updates—even when your phone stays behind—all from your wrist. Thanks to built-in LTE connectivity¹⁰, this smart fitness tracker keeps you connected to what matters.
        • WATCH PAIRS WITH YOUR ANDROID SMARTPHONE: Galaxy Watch works seamlessly with Samsung phones and also works with other Android phones.¹² Download the Galaxy Wearable and Samsung Health apps to get started using Galaxy Watch with your device.
